subject: Web Development
title: Data Privacy and GDPR
description: A quick, practical guide to Data Privacy and GDPR.

hook.text: The EU's GDPR fined companies billions for mishandling personal data since 2018.

buildup.text: GDPR requires explicit consent, data minimization, and the right to be forgotten.

discovery.text: Users can request all data a company holds on them — and demand its complete deletion.

twist.text: GDPR applies to any site with EU visitors, regardless of where the company is based.

climax.text: Privacy regulation turned data protection from a best practice into a legal obligation worldwide.

punchline.text: Collect less data and sleep better at night.

quiz.question: What does GDPR give users the right to?
